relations.text: ジョージア州にあるWeyerhaeuserの土地の採掘リース(Weyerhaeuser Lease)を2026年8月に引き継いだ
relations.text_en: Took over a mining lease on Weyerhaeuser land in Georgia (the Weyerhaeuser Lease) in August 2026

relations.text: Builders FirstSourceが10-Kで、最大級の仕入先の一社としてWeyerhaeuserを挙げる
relations.text_en: Builders FirstSource names Weyerhaeuser among its largest suppliers

source.label: Builders FirstSource 10-K(2024年度)
source.quote: Our largest suppliers are national companies such as Boise Cascade Company, Weyerhaeuser Company, West Fraser Timber Co.

relations.text: BlueLinxが10-Kで、仕入先の大手メーカーの一社としてWeyerhaeuserを挙げる
relations.text_en: BlueLinx lists Weyerhaeuser among its leading manufacturer suppliers

source.label: BlueLinx 10-K(2024年度)
source.quote: Our suppliers include some of the leading manufacturers in the industry, such as Allura, Arauco, Fiberon, Georgia-Pacific, Huber Engineered Woods, Louisiana-Pacific, Oldcastle APG, Ply Gem, Roseburg, Royal and Weyerhaeuser.

relations.text: Boise Cascadeが10-Kで、エンジニアードウッドの主な競合としてWeyerhaeuserを挙げる(仕入先でもある)

source.quote: In EWP, we compete against several major North American EWP producers, such as Weyerhaeuser Company, Pacific Woodtech Corporation, and Roseburg Forest Products
